title: Jun Ioneda: the website is drawn in the artist's own style
note: A Brazilian illustrator. Big bouncy rounded type in three colours per sentence, an illustrated hill and a lying figure fixed along the bottom of every screen, and badge stickers (WALL PAPERS, BUY PRINTS) in the corners. The copy is honest: "Not all my work was commissioned. I also create a lot of stuff just for fun." Worth taking: the interface is made from the same material as the work.
